facts.business: Hindustan Media Ventures Limited is engaged in printing and publishing of newspapers and periodicals, primarily the Hindustan brand, across northern India including Delhi NCR, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Bihar, and Jharkhand.

segments.name: Printing and publishing of newspaper & periodicals

capacity_or_capex.item: Printing and publishing of newspaper & periodicals

key_risks: Impairment of brand value (INR 6,696 lakhs) due to sensitivity in projected revenue growth, operating margin, long-term growth rate, and discount rates
Dependence on print advertising revenue amid shifting news consumption habits
facts.related_party_note: The company has pledged part of its investment in mutual funds and fixed deposits to fulfill collateral requirements for borrowing. The Group's interest in HT Content Studio LLP is accounted for using the equity method.
